# ProksiAbel OÜ

> ProksiAbel OÜ is an EU-based (Estonia) offensive security consultancy specializing in MITM attack defense, web application penetration testing, vulnerability management, and secure development practices. The site is bilingual (Estonian/English).

ProksiAbel OÜ (registry code 17017826) runs hands-on penetration tests of web applications and authentication flows, builds practical countermeasures against MITM attacks and client fingerprinting, and develops custom security research tooling. Services: Penetration Testing & Vulnerability Management, Secure Development Practices, Security Research & Tool Development.

## Pages

- [Home](https://proksiabel.ee/): Services overview, expertise, about, and contact.
- [FIDO2 vs Passkeys: A Technical Guide](https://proksiabel.ee/guides/fido2-vs-passkeys): Protocol-level comparison of FIDO2 (WebAuthn + CTAP2) and passkeys — discoverable credentials, attestation, backup eligibility, and relying-party implementation guidance.
- [SSRF Explained: Attack Examples & Prevention](https://proksiabel.ee/guides/ssrf-explained): Server-side request forgery (SSRF) deep-dive — attack anatomy, cloud metadata credential theft (169.254.169.254), deny-list bypasses, Suricata/Semgrep detection rules, and allowlist-based fix patterns in Python, Go, and Node.js, with a reproducible docker-compose lab.
- [IDOR Explained: Attack Examples & Prevention](https://proksiabel.ee/guides/idor-explained): Insecure direct object reference (IDOR) / broken object level authorization (BOLA) deep-dive — missing object-level authorization, read/write IDOR with a reproducible docker-compose lab, two-account detection methodology, a Semgrep taint rule template, and ownership-check fix patterns in Python, Node.js, and Go.
- [Security Headers Checklist: How to Configure and Verify HTTP Security Headers](https://proksiabel.ee/guides/security-headers-checklist): Priority-ordered HTTP security headers checklist — exact values for HSTS, Content-Security-Policy, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, COOP/CORP/COEP, what each header breaks when enabled, config examples (Cloudflare _headers, Nginx, Caddy, Express/helmet), curl-based verification, and a CI gate script.
- [Privacy Policy](https://proksiabel.ee/privacy): How ProksiAbel OÜ handles your data.
- [Terms of Service](https://proksiabel.ee/terms): Terms for the consultancy's services.
- [Cookie Policy](https://proksiabel.ee/cookies): Only essential security cookies; no tracking.
- [Responsible Disclosure](https://proksiabel.ee/disclosure): How to report security vulnerabilities.
